text:
Lia: Found plaintext partner token in staging webhook logs (s3://redwood-logs/staging/webhooks/2026-03-21/partner-debug.log). Paging @security @oncall.

Ben: Ack. Paste a redacted snippet and path?

Lia: snippet: `2026-03-21T17:12:08Z INFO webhook received payload, partner_token=*****ABcdEfGhIjKLMN***** user_id=zz12`
Object: s3://redwood-logs/staging/webhooks/2026-03-21/partner-debug.log

Mateo: Partner token TTL? ephemeral or long-lived service key?

Lia: Appears ephemeral (~1h), first seen ~2h ago. No outbound anomalies in egress logs yet.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-0321-7 opened, severity=P2, assigned to eng-security.

Ciara: Triage plan: 1) Archive original object to locked archive (chain-of-custody) 2) Overwrite public object with scrubbed copy 3) Ask partner to revoke/rotate 4) Rotate Vault entry + rollout staging 5) Short-term RBAC to restrict read on staging logs prefix 6) Add pre-ingest redaction.

Ben: Archive command: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/staging/webhooks/2026-03-21/partner-debug.log s3://redwood-sec-archive/incident-<id>/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control`
Compute md5 and record operator. Do not overwrite until archive confirmed.

Mateo: Vault rotation plan: `vault kv put secret/staging/partner token="<new-token>"` then update k8s secret/template and rolling restart webhook-deployment. After partner confirms revoke, remove old key from Vault or mark rotated.

Ciara: Messaging partner now for immediate revoke and replacement. Lia, please snapshot.

Lia: Archive copy done to s3://redwood-sec-archive/incident-3067890123/partner-debug.log; permissions locked, md5 recorded.

Ciara: Partner confirmed revoke and issued new token. I pushed new token to Vault (encrypted). Mateo proceed with rollout.

Mateo: Rolled out new secret to staging; rolling restart started at 17:45 UTC. Ben to validate integration calls.

Ben: Verified webhook calls succeed with new token; no error spike. Overwrote public log with scrubbed file and added header noting archival per INC-2026-0321-7.

Ciara: Post-incident actions: enable Vault audit logging to SIEM, implement pre-ingest scrubber for common token patterns, apply S3 lifecycle to limit raw staging webhook retention to 7 days unless archived, conduct RBAC review and enforce MFA for access to raw logs.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0321-7 resolved at 18:05 UTC (auto).

Ciara: Closing — no evidence of external use, partner rotated, Vault updated, logs archived/scrubbed. Lia to write a short postmortem and update runbooks (due EOD+3).

Lia: Will do. Assigning GH issue for pre-ingest scrubber to devex + infra. Thanks all :thumbsup:
